artifact.title: Canonical Artifact Ontology
artifact.purpose: Defines the minimum normative characteristics required of every canonical AKS artifact.
change_summary: Expanded ontology from R011 through R024.
Introduced classification, property, identity, integrity, and determinism requirements.

requirements.title: Artifact Classification
requirements.statement: Every canonical artifact SHALL declare exactly one primary artifact class.
requirements.rationale: Classification governs lifecycle, validation, and stewardship.
requirements.verification: Verify exactly one primary artifact class is declared.

requirements.title: Artifact Classification Stability
requirements.statement: An artifact's primary class SHALL NOT change during its lifetime.
requirements.rationale: Classification changes imply a different conceptual artifact.

requirements.title: Required Properties
requirements.statement: Every canonical artifact SHALL explicitly declare every required property defined by its governing artifact class.
requirements.verification: Verify all required properties are present.

requirements.title: Unknown Properties
requirements.statement: Implementations MAY include additional non-canonical properties provided they do not alter normative meaning.
requirements.verification: Verify extensions do not alter canonical semantics.

requirements.title: Property Authority
requirements.statement: Every AKS-defined property SHALL possess exactly one normative definition.
requirements.verification: Verify each canonical property has one governing definition.

requirements.title: Identity Continuity
requirements.statement: An artifact SHALL retain its identity across revisions that do not alter conceptual purpose.

requirements.title: Successor Artifacts
requirements.statement: When conceptual continuity ends, a new artifact SHALL receive a new identity.

requirements.title: Artifact Completeness
requirements.statement: A canonical artifact SHALL satisfy all requirements applicable to its class.

requirements.title: Artifact Consistency
requirements.statement: A canonical artifact SHALL NOT contain contradictory canonical property values.

requirements.title: Self-Describing Artifacts
requirements.statement: Artifacts SHALL contain sufficient metadata to determine identity, class, governing specification, version, and authority.

requirements.title: Identity Reuse
requirements.statement: An identity SHALL NOT be reassigned to a different canonical artifact.
requirements.rationale: Traceability depends on unique persistent identity.

requirements.title: Orphaned Canonical Artifacts
requirements.statement: Every canonical artifact SHALL identify its governing specification or authority.

requirements.title: Duplicate Canonical Artifacts
requirements.statement: Two canonical artifacts SHALL NOT share one identity while differing normatively.
requirements.rationale: Identity uniquely identifies one governed concept.

requirements.title: Canonical Determinism
requirements.statement: Independent conforming implementations SHALL derive the same normative interpretation.
